hero.title: Prepare for pregnancy. Nurture every stage. Raise with confidence.
hero.body: WonderHug.Life brings Garbh Sanskar practice, modern wellness education and a WhatsApp community of 50,000+ mothers together — from planning a pregnancy to conscious parenting.
hero.logoCaption: Two arms. One hug. A heart at the centre.
hero.getStarted: Get started — it’s free to begin

journey.heading: Where are you right now?
journey.help: Choose a stage and up to two goals. Recommendations follow you — and a signed-in account can keep them.

home.ecosystemTitle: Garbh Sanskar, programmes, and the shop
home.ecosystemBody: Education and practice for Telugu-speaking families first, then pan-India English. Not a clinic.
home.companionTitle: A companion that can learn your stage, week and language — without guessing medical facts.
home.companionBody: Today we remember the journey you select on this device. A WonderHug profile can hold pregnancy week, baby age, saved articles and completed activities.
home.beginBody: Tell us your journey. We will keep the next step small, kind and free of invented medical certainty.

shop.title: Shop
shop.intro: Digital practice packs and print-ready journals priced in Indian rupees. These are wellness products, not medicines.

programs.title: Wellness programs
programs.intro: Structured programmes for Beej Sanskar, pregnancy (Womb Care) and the fourth trimester. Education and practice — not a clinic.

auth.title: Your WonderHug account
auth.phoneHelp: Indian mobile numbers work best. OTP is sent by Supabase when keys are configured.

cart.title: Cart
cart.demo: Razorpay keys are not in this environment. Checkout will record a demo order so you can complete the flow.

community.whatsappBody: Over 50,000 mothers are already in WonderHug rooms on WhatsApp (AiSensy). The website rooms are for quieter, moderated threads. The daily conversation lives on WhatsApp.

admin.title: WonderHug CMS
admin.help: Create, edit, unpublish and delete every public page and catalogue item. Content loads from Supabase when connected, and from this browser when it is not.

common.pendingPhoto: Official photography will replace this illustration when WonderHug supplies it.
